<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.59.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [chore] Make /_stcore/metrics memory stats cheap by default by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15472
* [chore] Remove deprecated Snowpark connection by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15784
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Add `ButtonColumn` to `st.column_config` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14544
* `st.set_page_config` - Add `"locked"` option for `initial_sidebar_state` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15459
* [feature] Add list support to programmatic secrets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15491
* [feature] Recommend installing skills on app startup by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15437
* [feature] Add AppTest support for download_button and image by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15528
* [feature] Add column statistics submenu to `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14307
* [feature] Add `streamlit docs <command>` lookup by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15547
* [feat] Add MarkdownColumn for st.dataframe and st.data_editor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13931
* [feature] Add `App.run()` to launch via `python app.py` or `uv run app.py`  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15563
* [feature] Support pasting files into st.chat_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15558
* [feature] Add `server.xsrfCookieSameSite` config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15634
* [feat] Add mermaid diagram support in st.markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14022
* [feature] Support OpenAI Responses API streams in st.write_stream by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15559
* [fragmentOutsideWrites][feature] Reset outside wrappers across fragment reruns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15620
* [fragmentOutsideWrites][feature] Allow fragments to write into outside containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15623
* [feature] Add per-user analytics on metrics endpoint by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15557
* [feature] Add skeleton element for loading placeholder UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15169
* [feat] Add `anchors` parameter to `st.markdown` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15722
* [feature] Add resolution parameter to st.camera_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15766
* [feature] Add in-app install-skills nudge toast by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15473
* [feature] Add `submit_mode` parameter to `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14344
* [feature] Add persist_state widget parameter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15645
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Metrics endpoint error with SQLAlchemy connections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15334
* [fix] TypeError in _run_with_thread_state when using [USER].fragment(run_every=...) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15376
* [fix] P-mode PIL palette hashing to prevent hash collisions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15397
* [fix] Use named Snowflake connection from config file by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15382
* [fix] Bind IPv6 dual-stack wildcard for default server address by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15400
* [fix] Clear stale and invalid auth cookies on login by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15420
* Fix: sync widgetMgr to fix tab.open lazy loading by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15460
* [fix] Discover installed CCv2 components in AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15488
* [fix] Prevent resetting page title on rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15527
* [fix] Accept formatted labels in AppTest format_func widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15564
* Fix: `st.pills` & `st.segmented_control` callback by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15522
* [fix] Default to polling file watcher in WSL by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15562
* [fix] Prevent "Missing Submit Button" flash on app load by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15561
* [fix] Explain multi-replica cause in invalid session upload error by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15635
* [fix] Keep selectbox selection when format_func depends on object identity by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15639
* [fix] Prevent ESC from clearing st.multiselect selection by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15646
* [fix] Validate StreamlitPage source matches registered page (#10572) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15721
* [fix] Ignore dataframe Ctrl+F shortcut when search is disabled by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15764
* [fix] Prevent line wrapping in dataframe column menu by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15772
### Other Changes
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15396
* [chore] Release v1.58.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15361
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15475
* [perf] VegaLiteChart: Use Vega's native resize API for faster resizing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15302
* [docs] Add parallel fragment guidance to developing-with-streamlit skill by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15503
* [docs] Remove experimental warning from App docstring by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15536
* [chore] Redesign pagination widget selected state styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15550
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15587
* [chore] Remove deprecated st.bokeh_chart command by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15636
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15665
* [docs] Add API reference to developing-with-streamlit skill by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15539
* `Baseweb` removal fixes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15737
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15758
